# William McIlleron

> William McIlleron builds fast websites for growing businesses, keeps them running after they go live, and runs the Google and Meta ads that send people to them. Based in Johannesburg, South Africa, working with businesses anywhere. One person: the person who quotes the job is the person who builds and maintains it.

## Services and prices

- Websites, built and run: R2,000 for a single page, R850 for each page after the first. Most sites land between R5,000 and R25,000. A fixed price is quoted before work starts.
- Upkeep: optional, from R950 a month, covering hosting, backups and small changes. The price depends on what it covers.
- Ads: Google search ads for local service businesses, and short ad videos for Facebook and Instagram made from the client's own job photos. The client pays Google and Meta directly from their own card. Quoted per business.
- Booking systems: customers book themselves, connected to Google Calendar or a free booking tool. Quoted per business.
- Brands: logo, colours, type and templates, so a business looks the same on its site, Google profile and social pages. Quoted per business.
- Social media: posts made from the client's own photos and videos, planned a month at a time. Quoted per business.
- Bigger, more technical builds: backends, integrations and automation, such as payment splits and row-level database security.

## Client work

- [MVS Global Pools case study](https://williammcilleron.com/work/mvs-global-pools/): a pool company in Greenstone, Johannesburg, founded in 2014, with eleven staff and no website until August 2026. Live at https://mvsglobalpools.co.za
- [Kōhī by Ifuku case study](https://williammcilleron.com/work/kohi-by-ifuku/): a café and listening room in Milpark, Johannesburg. Rebuilt in 2026; it loads in 1.1 seconds on a phone, down from 5.9. Live at https://www.kohibyifuku.co.za
- [All work](https://williammcilleron.com/work/): client sites, Silver Lakes Marketplace, technical projects, and products that were built and stopped, with the reasons.
